## Work Experience

### Backend Developer | Blask, Tbilisi (Jul 2024 - Present)
- High-Load Data & Query Tuning: Designed and optimized PostgreSQL schemas and analytical queries for a B2B iGaming market analytics platform, resolving lock contention, tuning composite and partial indexes, and executing zero-downtime data migrations across microservices.
- Event-Driven Pipelines & Resiliency: Engineered asynchronous ingestion and cross-service synchronization pipelines using Kafka, BullMQ, and Redis with idempotent consumers, exponential backoff retries, and Dead Letter Queues (DLQ) to prevent event loss under load spikes.
- API Architecture & Contract Testing: Built high-throughput NestJS (TypeScript) REST services with strict DTO validation and rate limiting, maintaining system reliability through automated unit and E2E test suites in Jest.
- Legacy Decomposition & Tooling: Extracted tightly coupled domain modules into isolated services and automated schema validation, test generation, and cross-service refactoring using agentic AI workflows (Claude Code, MCP).

### Full Stack Developer | DIBSCapital, Tel Aviv (Jun 2022 - Jun 2024)
- Fintech & KYC Integrations: Integrated core real-estate investment workflows with regulated financial providers (North Capital escrow/KYC, InvestReady accreditation, and Stripe payments), implementing webhook signature verification, idempotency keys, and compliance audit trails.
- AWS Cloud Infrastructure: Deployed and operated containerized Node.js backend workloads across AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, SQS), configuring queue-backed transaction processing and automated failure alerting.
- Full-Stack Product Delivery: Built investor onboarding flows, portfolio dashboards, and document signing interfaces in React backed by typed Node.js and PostgreSQL REST APIs.

### Backend Developer | Nublecraft (Apr 2021 - Jun 2022)

### Live Video Streaming Engineer | Specmedia, Minsk (Mar 2017 - Jun 2020)

## Featured Projects

### SplitBot: Shared Expense Splitting ([botsplit.com](https://botsplit.com))
- Role: Creator & Full-Stack Engineer
- Status: Production / Live
- Tech: TypeScript, React 19, Vite, WebSockets, PostgreSQL, Redis, Multimodal AI (VLM), Telegram Mini App, Terraform, Cloudflare
- Description: Production Telegram Mini App and bot for collaborative group expense splitting with zero-onboarding authentication (Telegram WebApp HMAC-SHA256 initData). Features a Multimodal Vision AI (VLM) OCR pipeline with strict JSON schema validation and arithmetic reconciliation that extracts receipt items, taxes, and tips and translates dish names across 21 languages in a single inference pass; live multi-user item claiming over WebSockets with Redis Pub/Sub fanout; and a multi-currency ledger using exact NUMERIC arithmetic deployed on GCP Cloud Run and Cloudflare via Terraform.

### NeyroNews: Autonomous AI News Pipeline ([neyronews.com](https://neyronews.com))
- Role: Creator & System Architect
- Status: Production / Live
- Tech: PostgreSQL, pgvector, LLM Orchestration, bge-m3 Embeddings, Telegram Bot API, Cloudflare Pages, Docker
- Description: Autonomous AI news curation and broadcasting pipeline delivering filtered technical digests with Human-in-the-Loop editorial moderation. Continuously polls 10+ technical AI sources and eliminates duplicates in two stages: canonical URL SHA-256 hashing followed by PostgreSQL pgvector cosine distance checks (< 0.08 threshold across a 72h rolling window) using local bge-m3 embeddings. Combines a lightweight triage scorer (grading technical substance 1-10) with structured LLM synthesis, Telegram inline callback moderation, and a scheduled broadcast engine using PostgreSQL `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`.

### Ściežka: Outdoor Route-Planning Workspace ([scezka.com](https://scezka.com))
- Role: Creator & Core Architect
- Status: Production / Live
- Tech: TypeScript, Node.js 24, Hono, React 19, PostgreSQL / PostGIS, Drizzle ORM, Rust, MapLibre GL, Turborepo, GCP Cloud Run
- Description: Outdoor route-planning workspace for cycling, running, and hiking with an interactive GIS map studio and a custom-built routing engine. Architected as a TypeScript Turborepo workspace (Node.js 24, Hono, Drizzle ORM, React 19) backed by PostgreSQL with PostGIS spatial indexing, Redis caching, and Strava OAuth2 webhook synchronization on GCP Cloud Run, alongside a high-performance routing service written in Rust (Axum, Tokio, memory-mapped OpenStreetMap PBF graphs, and DEM elevation tiles).
